reviews.title: Awesome quality and my go-to for recording!
reviews.comment: These microphones are freaking awesome! I particularly like to use some when I had to go private dance lessons in a studio where I record me and the instructor. They do an exceptional job of just catching our voices even when there’s loud music going on around and other instructors with a lot of echo. But these microphones made just our voice is super clear! and they lasted forever as far as charge goes! I gone up to two hours using them and didn’t have to charge them once in that time and quality was consistent throughout that whole time. I love the convenience of having the little pack and being able to use both the old iPhone lightning charger or the USB-C. The magnets are pretty good as long as you don’t smack them which we have done a couple times and then they would fall off, but that’s understandable. I will say that when they did fall, they didn’t break and Anytime that we actually rubbed up against the microphone with our hands or her arms or anything there was never any feedback or distortion of sound. These are truly great and have worked wonderful for my purposes. I have used it in separate rooms and it’s worked well and I’ve gotten a good distance away as well and they were just perfect super easy to actually get them to sync up and start nothing to download, which is nice and just simple to use great value for the cost and can be used for so many different applications. Definitely recommend these.

reviews.title: Great affordable quality sound!
reviews.comment: These have taken our content creation to the next level so simply. They are truly easy to use via connecting them to your phone and wearing them with versatility. The size and quality seems just right. The quality of sound is vastly better.  We chose to buy these before going in Studio and spending those kinds of funds. I am so grateful that we decided to stay at a DIY level by using these as a tool as well as some in-home purchased lighting and a few other tools. This is exactly what we needed, and I’m sure suitable for amateurs and professionals alike. I also want to mention that there were cheaper options available, but I am glad we chose to spend a bit more and get even better quality, because that will affect our content over the long run, and it was worth the extra expense on the front end.

reviews.title: The Best Video Mics I Have Ever Owned
reviews.comment:
I am a full-time content, creator and videographer and have owned pretty much every wireless mic system that has come out in the last five years. the problem I was trying to solve is finding one that was reliable enough and had a battery life long enough to shoot all day. I also found other options too heavy as I often clip mics onto my T-shirt. When I found the Hollyland Lark M2s I was attracted to them because of the magnetic mount and the size of the mic. It was small enough not to pull and tug on my T-shirt and allow me to inconspicuously place it on anything I'm wearing. Here's why it has become my go-to mic for daily video content creation.
Mic Size & Mic Mount
At about half the size of other wireless mic systems. I am shocked at how good the audio is compared to the size of this mic. The receiver was almost, and with the magnetic clasp can be stuck on any style of shirt, or even the bill of a hat. I love the fact that they also have stickers that you can put over the logo so the simply looks like a black circle. My favorite mic design ever.
Always Connects
With other mics, I felt like I was always checking to see if audio was recording diligently before the beginning of shoot. With these, I rarely do that because they always connect and always begin recording without any issues.
Phone Connector
I do most of my shooting on my Sony A7iv I do occasionally pick up my iPhone to record bits and pieces. The USB-C and iPhone connectors make a huge difference. They connect seamlessly and I don't ever have to worry if audio is being captured or not. That's really the theme of these mics. They connect without any issues and always work without fail.
Battery Life
Even though I use it every day, it feels like I only need to charge this mic once a month. I have to remind myself to charge it up before I go out on important shoots because I'm not used to needing to charge. Also since I typically only use one mic, since this system has two I always have a back up that I can connect if my main mic dies.
Carrying/Charging Case
I love how small the carrying and charging case is. Smaller than even the DJI mic systems I have owned. this makes it easy to throw in my camera bag and even easier to get out and use. It's barely bigger than my AirPods case.
Summary
If you are a content creator, then this is absolutely the best wireless mic option that I have found. For the price, it's truly unbeatable. In professional settings, people are blown away at the size and performance. This will be my mic of choice until something revolutionary comes along and knocks it off the throne. But whatever that is, it must truly be revolutionary. That's how much I love these mics.
